decision.next_action: use the common compiled host only for public benchmark reproduction; request source RESP/GAFF/GLYCAM files and independently review the host graph, charge derivation, and guest parameters before PaG or MC-Q1

limitations: A compiled parm7 contains numerical charges and terms but not the full derivation, quantum-chemistry inputs, atom typing history, or original source parameter files.
Exact equality across deposited sugar systems would show internal reuse, not chemical validation.
The deposited .rst members are AMBER restraint-control inputs, not coordinate restart files; no standalone restart coordinate was found in this archive.
Trajectory frames can be interpreted with the matching topology, but the exact simulation-start coordinates are not deposited as a restart file here.
The public host is a truncated GluHUT benchmark system, not the complete NNC2215 insulin conjugate.
No compiled parameter is assumed transferable to PaG or MC-Q1.
not_target_claim: not NNC2215, PaG, MC-Q1, affinity, efficacy, safety, or a drug result

head: Note: There are two SMD run types for galactose, 'a' and 'b'. These correspond to the direction of cavity exit from the bound state, as mentioned in both the main document as well as the supplementary information.

scope: public GluHUT SMD compiled AMBER systems
